mapper.sql: select b.batch_id, b.batch_no, b.product_id, p.product_name, b.plot_id, vp.plot_name, b.workshop_id, w.workshop_name, p.enterprise_id, e.enterprise_name, b.entry_workshop_time, b.harvest_date, b.harvest_location, b.total_yield_l, b.status, b.del_flag, b.remark, b.create_by, b.create_time, b.update_by, b.update_time from trace_batch b left join trace_product p on p.product_id = b.product_id left join trace_enterprise e on e.enterprise_id = p.enterprise_id left join trace_vineyard_plot vp on vp.plot_id = b.plot_id left join trace_workshop w on w.workshop_id = b.workshop_id
mapper.select: select count(1) from trace_batch where product_id = #{productId} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select count(1) from trace_batch where plot_id = #{plotId} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select count(1) from trace_batch where workshop_id = #{workshopId} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into trace_batch ( batch_no, product_id, plot_id, workshop_id, entry_workshop_time, harvest_date, harvest_location, total_yield_l, status, remark, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{batchNo}, #{productId}, #{plotId}, #{workshopId}, #{entryWorkshopTime}, #{harvestDate}, #{harvestLocation}, #{totalYieldL}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
